sql:
SELECT AVG(COALESCE(o.oxygen_count, 0)) as avg_oxygen
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
) m
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(*) as oxygen_count
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.element = 'o'
    GROUP BY a.molecule_id
) o ON m.molecule_id = o.molecule_id
